output.one_liner: Close is a SaaS CRM platform that provides sales teams with calling, email, SMS, and AI agents for managing leads and automating sales workflows.

auth.notes: API Keys use HTTP Basic Auth with key as username and empty password. OAuth 2.0 uses authorization_code grant with refresh token support. Bearer tokens used with OAuth access tokens.

evidence.snippet: API Keys — Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations. Use HTTP Basic Auth with your API key as the username and an empty password.
Send your HTTP requests with an Authorization header that contains the word Bearer followed by a space and the Access Token.

access.notes: 14-day free trial available to anyone. Free secondary organizations available to existing Close users. Free Dev organizations available on request to partners without Close account.

evidence.snippet: 14-day free trial · We'll help you move your data, get set up, and start selling in Close.
Already a Close user — You can create a free secondary organization.
Integration partners who don't use Close in their own sales process can request a free Dev organization by emailing support@close.com

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits enforced per endpoint group and per organization. Organization-wide limits are 3x higher than per-API-key limits.

evidence.snippet: Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
Configure webhook subscriptions to receive real-time event notifications from Close.
API requests are limited at a per Organization level across all users' API keys.
The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp and has HTTP Streamable and OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration support.
MCP Server - Model Context Protocol for AI agents.
Close's MCP server is officially supported across the Claude ecosystem.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API credentials (free trial, free dev orgs, API keys, OAuth), comprehensive REST API with OpenAPI spec, official MCP server, and clear documentation enable building a toolkit today.

overview_evidence.snippet: Build integrations, automate workflows, and extend Close for your team.
Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
